newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates dip on liquidity flow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates dip on liquidity flow.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates ended down on Saturday as the liquidity flow remained high despite the outflow of 1.09 billion rupees by the way of Short-Term Federal Bonds, dealers said.

"Lenders opened books at 5.0 percent, but brought the rates down to 3.0 percent, where substantial amounts were traded. The rates fell further to 1.0 percent, but settled at 2.0 percent at the close," a dealer at KASB & Co said.
He said banks showed interest in one-month tenor and were willing to borrow at 13 percent, but lenders stayed away.
